faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subline: Everything you want to know before getting started.

items.q: Can I start without a credit card?
items.a: Yes. Up to 3 vehicles, Autiqa is always free — no time limit, no credit card required. Beyond 3 vehicles, the paid plan is 13 PLN per vehicle per month. You only provide payment details when you decide to expand.

items.q: How does Autiqa notify me about upcoming inspections and insurance renewals?
items.a: Autiqa tracks inspection deadlines, insurance expiry, and other policy dates for every vehicle in your fleet. Upcoming deadlines appear in the fleet view well ahead of time — before a car gets grounded and before you lose revenue.

items.q: How long does it take to onboard my fleet?
items.a: Most operators add their first vehicles within 15 minutes. You just need a license plate and basic vehicle details. Drivers, deadlines, and finance data can be filled in gradually — the system works from the moment you add the first vehicle.

items.q: Does Autiqa work for tourist car rental?
items.a: Yes. Autiqa supports both taxi and ride-hail fleets and tourist rental operators. You track vehicle availability, per-rental revenue, and compliance deadlines between bookings — so no policy slips through the gap between one customer and the next.

items.q: Can I see how much each vehicle earns separately?
items.a: Yes. The finance view shows revenue, costs (fuel, maintenance, insurance), and net margin at the individual vehicle level. You get a direct answer to: which vehicle is profitable, and which is costing more than it earns.

items.q: What if my fleet exceeds 40 vehicles?
items.a: For fleets above 40 vehicles, we arrange custom terms — a dedicated account manager, priority support, and the option to integrate with your existing systems. Get in touch and we'll work out the details.
